question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

Riding a horse was __a piece of cake__ for him.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"a piece of cake"** means something that is very easy to do or accomplish. (बहुत आसान काम)

 
 
• **Example: **For him, solving complex mathematical problems is a piece of cake.
 
 
 
• **"A very easy task"** refers to something that can be done with minimal effort or difficulty. (बहुत आसान काम)
 
 
• **Example: **Setting up the new software was a very easy task for the IT team.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the phrase **"a piece of cake"** is synonymous with **"a very easy task"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **A very difficult task** (बहुत कठिन कार्य): Something that requires a lot of effort and is hard to accomplish.

 
 
• **Example:** Climbing Mount Everest is a very difficult task that only a few can achieve.
 
 
 
• **An everyday affair** (रोजमर्रा का काम): Something that happens regularly or is a common occurrence.
 
 
• **Example:** For her, going to the gym has become an everyday affair.
 
 
 
• **Confusing work** (उलझाने वाला काम): Tasks that are difficult to understand or that cause confusion.
 
 
• **Example:** The instructions for assembling the furniture were so vague that it turned into confusing work.
